skills.name: bulk-pause
skills.description: Pause (or resume) many UptimeRobot monitors at once — by tag, name, URL, or state — around a deployment or maintenance window.

skills.name: conventions
skills.description: Conventions and gotchas for every UptimeRobot MCP tool call — monitor types, URL formats, HEARTBEAT URL handling, discovery-before-writes, pagination, time ranges, errors, rate limits, and output style. Use whenever you call any uptimerobot:* tool.

skills.name: create-api-monitor
skills.description: Create an API monitor that calls an HTTP endpoint and runs 1–5 assertions on the response, combined with AND/OR logic; alerts when they fail.

skills.name: create-dns-monitor
skills.description: Create a DNS monitor that queries a domain and alerts when the DNS server does not answer or, optionally, when records differ from expected values.

skills.name: create-heartbeat-monitor
skills.description: Create a HEARTBEAT (cron/job) monitor: UptimeRobot generates a URL that the job must ping on schedule, and alerts when the pings stop.

skills.name: create-http-monitor
skills.description: Create an HTTP monitor in UptimeRobot that checks a URL for a successful HTTP response on an interval.

skills.name: create-keyword-monitor
skills.description: Create a KEYWORD monitor that fetches a URL and alerts when a given keyword appears in, or is missing from, the response.

skills.name: create-ping-monitor
skills.description: Create a PING monitor that sends ICMP echo requests to a hostname or IP and alerts when the host stops responding.

skills.name: create-port-monitor
skills.description: Create a PORT monitor that opens a TCP connection to a host and port and alerts when the port stops accepting connections.

skills.name: create-udp-monitor
skills.description: Create a UDP monitor that sends a packet to a host and port and alerts on no response, with optional payload, response keyword and packet-loss threshold.

skills.name: errors
skills.description: Interpret UptimeRobot MCP errors — map the plain-text messages to their meaning, decide whether to retry, and tell the user how to recover.

skills.name: incident-response
skills.description: End-to-end incident workflow — find what's down, diagnose it, pause flapping monitors, and verify recovery.

skills.name: incidents
skills.description: List downtime incidents (including ongoing ones) and read one incident's details, activity log, and sent alerts.

skills.name: list-integrations
skills.description: Find the alert-contact IDs (integrations such as Slack or webhooks, plus personal email/SMS/voice/push contacts) to attach to UptimeRobot monitors.

skills.name: maintenance-windows
skills.description: Schedule one-off or recurring maintenance windows that suppress alerts for planned downtime, as an alternative to bulk-pause.

skills.name: manage-monitor-groups
skills.description: Choose between monitor groups and tags for organizing monitors, and create, fill, move between, or delete monitor groups. Tags are usually the better default.

skills.name: manage-monitors
skills.description: Find monitors with list-monitors filters, read one monitor's details, and pause or resume monitors in UptimeRobot.

skills.name: monitor-health-summary
skills.description: Generate a one-shot health snapshot — monitor counts by state, which are currently down or paused, recent incident count, and total downtime — useful as a daily brief or ad-hoc check.

skills.name: quick-monitor-setup
skills.description: Create a free UptimeRobot HTTPS uptime monitor for someone using ONLY their email, no UptimeRobot account, no API key, and no MCP/OAuth. The agent calls an unauthenticated proof-of-work-gated API; the owner confirms with one click in an activation email. Use when a user wants monitoring but is not signed in to UptimeRobot and has no API key, the zero-setup path.

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Connect and authenticate the hosted UptimeRobot MCP server (OAuth over streamable HTTP), OR diagnose why `uptimerobot:*` MCP tools aren't visible in the current session. Invoke this skill any time you cannot see UptimeRobot tools, before telling the user the MCP is misconfigured — Step 0 detects the most common case (server already connected, tools loaded after session start) and resolves it without re-authenticating. Also invoke on plain-text auth errors (unauthorized, unauthenticated, token expired / invalid) or first-time setup.

skills.name: sla-report
skills.description: Generate a per-monitor SLA report for a time range — uptime percentage, total downtime, and incident count per monitor — formatted as Markdown for sharing in Confluence, Slack, or post-mortem docs.

skills.name: stats
skills.description: Read account-wide monitor statistics (up/down/paused counts, uptime, incident totals) and per-monitor response-time series, and report the numbers in the right units.

skills.name: status-pages
skills.description: Create and publish a public status page from monitors, groups, or tags, and manage announcements (incident, maintenance, info notices) on it.

skills.name: update-monitor
skills.description: Modify an existing UptimeRobot monitor — rename, change URL/interval, swap alert contacts, retag, move between groups, and tweak type-specific settings — without losing the lists it replaces.
